purpose: Execution queue of the H/U/N/B/A/P/L/R clean-session roadmap pipeline; child tasks of the fixed criteria in docs/progress.json. Not a second roadmap and not an acceptance register.

score.rule: A verified task never changes the score; only the lead records acceptance with the required evidence level and owner/external approvals.

ranking: Ledger order is the rank. Criteria: (1) security prerequisites and regression risk, (2) unblocking impact on M7 native daily use, M8 security/network, M9 reference hardware and R release readiness, (3) user/developer utility, (4) strength of evidence obtainable here (host or native QEMU TCG), (5) smallest cohesive change with no path overlap with open PRs #333 and #336, the UI/UX pipeline or the S09 pipeline. Subjective ordering, not a computed score.

ownership.PR #333 (H02 native USB/HID): kernel/src/m2/xhci*, iommu.rs, paging.rs, window_session.rs, main.rs, m2.rs, drivers/xhci/, services/input-core/, sdk/examples/input-service/, tools/build.py, tools/run.py, tools/run_*hid*/xhci
ownership.UI/UX pipeline: ui/design/, docs/design/, ui/prototype/tokens.css, planned UX-G in ui/native and ui/graphics

tasks.title: Host installer orchestrator binding source verification, artifact commit and catalogue journal
tasks.goal: Add sdk/app-management/src/installer.rs: a bounded no_std orchestrator for install, update and remove that (1) verifies the package only through the existing app_package_core::SourceRegistry::verify_executable (no second verifier, no public self-constructible verified token), (2) derives PackageIdentity crate-internally from the SourceVerifiedExecutable, (3) streams the exact image through store::InstallTransaction and commits it, (4) re-checks the current source generation and revocation state immediately before catalogue prepare/apply so a rotate or revoke between verification and commit fails closed (APP-SOURCE-RECOVERY section 7), (5) applies catalog::InstallCatalog and persists through journal::Journal, and (6) maps store/journal Unknown to a fail-closed state without replay or automatic recommit. The SourceRegistry stays caller-supplied and in memory: no new trust root, anchor, durable source backend or launch capability.
tasks.why_now: A02 is open and every lower layer (package verification, source policy, streaming store, catalogue, journal) is host-tested but unconnected. A single orchestrator is the smallest step that proves the layers compose without authority gaps, and it is the prerequisite for the native installer service (A02-T3) and for A03/A04 app lifecycle work. Covered by an existing CI job.
tasks.graph_notes: Graphify (index d572052): SourceRegistry::verify_executable -> verify_executable_package -> SourceVerifiedExecutable::executable(); InstallCatalog prepare/apply/abort/mark_unknown/restart/reconcile in catalog.rs (tests install_update_remove_are_generation_bound_and_grant_nothing, rollback_source_switch_and_artifact_mixups_are_rejected, unknown_outcome_fails_closed_until_authoritative_reconcile); InstallTransaction begin/append/commit/cancel/outcome in store.rs; Journal format/recover_into/commit in journal.rs. CI: app-management-quality.yml#app-package-quality.
acceptance: install, update and remove succeed end to end in host tests over FakeStore-style media, and the installed entry carries zero grants
negative: either signature invalid, wrong or unknown source, revoked source, stale source generation
negative: rotate or revoke between verify_executable and catalogue apply fails closed with no catalogue mutation
negative: downgrade, source switch, artifact length or digest substitution, truncated stream
negative: store or journal Unknown leaves the catalogue uncertain, blocks replay and recommit until authoritative reconcile
source revoke rejects new install/update but keeps an already installed app launchable (lookup)
no unsafe code, no new dependency, no_std preserved, x86_64-unknown-none release build passes
APP-PACKAGES.md documents the orchestrator and its evidence boundary (host model only)
out_of_scope: durable source registry or anchors (A02-T2, owner decision)
native installer service or kernel launch (A02-T3)
tasks.non_claimable: Native install/update/remove, durable recovery on authenticated storage, physical power-cut behaviour and human security review stay open; A02 is not accepted by this task.
tasks.rollback: Revert the task commit; the orchestrator is additive and has no consumer yet.
tasks.next: A02-T3 native installer service after the launch ADR and B02 artifact store.

tasks.title: task-grant-core: time-bounded, revocable per-object task grants (host model)
tasks.goal: Create sdk/task-grant-core (no_std, forbid(unsafe_code)) and add it to the sdk workspace: grants of (app principal, process epoch) x (object id, revision) x {read, write, export} x {until-close, session}, generation-bound revoke, no delegation or inheritance to helper processes, no capability material in messages, bounded tables. Fail closed on stale epoch, stale generation, overflow and unknown object.
tasks.why_now: A03 has domain-level volume grants but no task-grant model; it is the policy core that the trusted grant UI (UX-C) and native broker (A03-T3) need. Host-only, covered by the sdk CI step.
acceptance: LP-08/09/10/29/31 negatives: new app without grants, internet-only app, old handle after revoke, helper re-use of a parent grant, export without export right
expiry at close and at session end; revoke invalidates outstanding handles by generation
table capacity overflow fails closed without evicting live grants
tasks.non_claimable: Native enforcement and visible UI stay open; A03 is not accepted by this task.
tasks.rollback: Revert the commit and the sdk workspace member line.
tasks.next: A03-T3 native broker after an ADR for per-object volume grants.

tasks.title: settings-core: typed, versioned, revertible settings with A/B persistence (host model)
tasks.goal: Create sdk/settings-core (no_std): typed versioned schema; validate, set and revert; A/B persistence over a media trait with SHA-256 for integrity only; fail closed on corruption or I/O error; never confirm a failed write; add it to the sdk workspace.
tasks.why_now: U05 needs a real settings service behind the shell's fixed Settings page; this is the smallest host-testable core and has no dependency on open PRs.
acceptance: negative: invalid value, unknown schema version, torn write at every byte offset, flush or read error, full medium, both copies corrupt
revert restores the previous committed value; a failed write is never reported as committed
tasks.non_claimable: Native settings service, encryption at rest and user tests stay open.
tasks.rollback: Revert the commit and the sdk workspace member line.
